phone.mind.choose.title: Where should Nocturne’s mind be?
phone.mind.choose.lead: A mind reads what you keep, writes your page each morning and answers your questions. Your memory stays on this phone unless you move it to a computer of your own.
phone.mind.choose.online.hint: A company you have an account with reads what you keep. You’ll copy three details from its website.
phone.mind.choose.computer.hint: Install Nocturne on your computer and move your memory there. This phone then works with it.
phone.mind.barLine: Nothing is turned on until the last step.
phone.mind.what.title: Have Nocturne’s mind work online, with a service you choose.
phone.mind.what.sent.label: Sent
phone.mind.what.sent: What you keep, so it can be read: your notes, photos and voice notes, your journal and check-ins. And your questions, with today’s date and what answers them, health readings included.
phone.mind.what.private.label: Private
phone.mind.private: Marking something private keeps it from coming up on its own, in reminders and notifications. It still goes to be read and helps answer what you ask.
phone.mind.what.need.label: You need
phone.mind.what.need: An account with that service. Most charge a little for what they read and write. Setting up means copying three details from its website.
phone.mind.details.title: Your service’s details
phone.mind.details.lead: Find these on your service’s website, often under developer settings or keys.
phone.mind.details.kept: The key is kept in this phone’s own safe place.
phone.mind.needsCheck: Continue works once the check passes.
phone.mind.check.unreachable.detail: Check it’s copied exactly, including the part after the last slash.
phone.mind.check.keyRefused.detail: Check you copied all of it. Some services also need credit on the account before a key works.
phone.mind.check.noCredit.detail: Add credit on its website, then check again.
phone.mind.check.modelMissing.detail: Copy the name exactly as its website shows it. Capitals and dashes matter.
phone.mind.check.noInternet.detail: Connect to the internet, then check again. Nothing was sent.
phone.mind.check.notHttps: That address doesn’t start with https://.
phone.mind.check.notHttps.detail: Online, Nocturne only connects to addresses that start with https://, so what it sends stays locked on the way. http:// works for your own network.
phone.mind.check.addressNotAllowed.detai: That kind of address never reads or answers. Use the address your service gives, with nothing after it. Nothing was sent.
phone.mind.check.busy.detail: It asked for a pause. Wait a moment, then check again.
phone.mind.check.serverError: {host} had a problem on its side.
phone.mind.check.serverError.detail: Try again in a few minutes.
phone.mind.check.emptyReply.detail: Check that the model name is exactly as its website shows it, then check again.
phone.mind.check.failed: That didn’t work. Nothing was sent.
phone.mind.limit.title: How much may go online each month?
phone.mind.limit.things: A number of things read and answered
phone.mind.limit.thingsLabel: Things read and answered in a month
phone.mind.limit.amountLabel: Amount in US dollars, in a month
phone.mind.limit.invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 upwards, like 200.
phone.mind.limit.invalidUsd: Enter an amount above zero, like 5.00.
phone.mind.limit.needs.number: Continue works once the limit is a whole number, like 200.
phone.mind.limit.needs.amount: Continue works once the amount is above zero, like 5.00.
phone.mind.agree.title: Before you turn this on, here is exactly what happens.
phone.mind.agree.lead: While this is on, what you keep and your questions go from this phone to {host}, so it can read them, write your page and answer.
phone.mind.agree.sent.heading: What is sent
phone.mind.agree.sent: Each thing you keep, so it can be read: its words, and the photo or recording itself when there is one. Your journal entries, good things and check-ins, so it can write your reflections and recaps. Each question with today’s date, and the lines that answer it. Each night, the lines your page is written from. For example:
phone.mind.agree.example: Kept 7:40 am · Dentist moved to Thursday at 9, Bridge Street.
phone.mind.agree.goes.heading: Where it goes
phone.mind.agree.goes: This phone sends it straight to {host}, which reads it and writes back. Nocturne keeps what it learned on this phone, with its receipts, and checks every receipt before you see it. Nothing passes through Nocturne’s makers.
phone.mind.agree.sees.heading: Who can see it
phone.mind.agree.sees: {host} can see everything sent, when it is sent, and this phone’s internet address. What it uses, {used}, may be made by another company that the service passes things to.
phone.mind.agree.seesAny: {host} can see everything sent, when it is sent, and this phone’s internet address. What it uses may be made by another company that the service passes things to.
phone.mind.agree.keeps: Nocturne can’t check what the service keeps, for how long, or whether it learns from what you send. Read its privacy page before you turn this on.
phone.mind.agree.private.heading: Private
phone.mind.agree.letGo: Things you let go are never sent.
phone.mind.agree.changes.heading: What changes
phone.mind.agree.changes: {host} reads what you keep, writes your page each morning and answers your questions, on your account with them, so it may charge for each. When the lines found aren’t enough to answer, {host} can ask to look a little further, and each look counts as one more thing answered, so one question can count up to 4 times. Reading happens when this phone allows it, often while it charges. If it can’t be reached, what you keep waits to be read and Ask finds by words.
phone.mind.agree.mind.heading: Changing your mind
phone.mind.agree.limit.things: At most {count, number} things a month are read and answered online, each look further counted as one; after that, what you keep waits to be read until the 1st.
phone.mind.agree.limit.amount: At most {amount} a month goes to the service; after that, what you keep waits to be read until the 1st.
phone.mind.agree.limit.none: There is no limit on how much is read and answered online.
phone.mind.agree.off: Turn it off at any time in {thisPhone}. What was already read stays in your memory on this phone.
phone.mind.agree.where: Every answer and every page says where it was written. {seeWhatWasSent} shows the exact words.
phone.mind.agree.failed: Nocturne couldn’t save this, so nothing was turned on. Try again.
phone.mind.reading.title: Reading what you kept
phone.mind.reading.body: Nocturne is reading {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} you kept, a few at a time. Your first page comes tomorrow morning.
phone.mind.reading.note: Reading carries on when this phone allows it, often while it charges.
phone.mind.row.monthLimit: {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} read and answered · limit {limit}
phone.mind.row.monthNone: {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} read and answered · no limit
phone.mind.noKey.title: Nocturne can’t read the saved key
phone.mind.noKey.body: The key for {host} can’t be opened on this phone. Ask finds by words until you check it.
phone.mind.off.title: Turn off Nocturne’s mind online?
phone.mind.off.body: What was read stays in your memory. What you keep from now waits to be read.
phone.mind.off.failed: That didn’t work. Nothing was changed.
phone.mind.trouble.refused.title: Your provider refused the key
phone.mind.trouble.refused.body: {host} no longer accepts the key Nocturne has. Until you check it, Ask finds by words.
phone.mind.trouble.noCredit.title: Your provider says there’s no credit left
phone.mind.trouble.noCredit.body: Add credit on your provider’s website, then check again. Until then, Ask finds by words.
phone.mind.trouble.paused.title: Paused by your limit
phone.mind.trouble.paused.body: You’ve reached this month’s limit. Ask finds by words until {day}.
phone.mind.trouble.offline: This phone isn’t online. What you keep waits to be read.
phone.mind.sent.title: What was sent
phone.mind.sent.dek: Everything this phone sent to {host}, word for word as it left. Kept for 90 days.
phone.mind.sent.error: Nocturne couldn’t read this list. Nothing was changed.
phone.mind.sent.asked.calendar: Your provider asked to look through your calendar for {days}.
phone.mind.sent.asked.journal: Your provider asked to look through your journal for {days}.
phone.mind.sent.asked.search: Your provider asked to look for “{words}”.
phone.mind.sent.asked.health: Your provider asked to look through your {kind} for {days}.
phone.mind.sent.resent: Each part sent the parts before it again, so your provider could follow on. The size counts every part, and each part counts once towards your monthly limit.
phone.mind.sent.footer: Older than 90 days are removed by themselves.
phone.mind.ask.notSure: Open each one to see which is right.
phone.mind.ask.sent: What was sent is listed in {thisPhone}. Choose {seeWhatWasSent}.
phone.mind.ask.noAnswer: No answer came this time. Ask again in a moment.
phone.mind.ask.failed: This couldn’t be answered just now. Ask again in a moment.
